name: irrlicht-panel
description: A read-only Irrlicht panel inside Claude Code: every agent session the Irrlicht daemon watches, across agents, with state, branch, tokens, context and model, plus the quota of the account this session bills against. Reads GET /api/v1/sessions from the local daemon; writes nothing.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel by itself
autoOpen.description: In the full-screen layout, open the Irrlicht panel as a sidebar by itself when the terminal is wide enough. Off: it opens only when you type /irrlicht, which always works.
